controls.dark_comet_source: Seligman et al. 2023, PSJ 4, 35 -- significant non-radial non-gravitational accelerations in inactive objects, attributed to hidden outgassing; extended by Farnocchia & Seligman 2024 (PNAS) to two distinct populations
controls.note: no known artificial object is in this sample, which is the expected outcome -- most have impacted, left the neighbourhood, or predate the survey.  The control is unexercised, NOT passed; sensitivity to the artificiality discriminant is untested until one appears.

empirical_envelope.reason: only 12 objects with both H and a value

replication.note: replication tests need a parent of >=200 screened objects and >=5 anomalies; below that the matched null cannot be populated and any p-value would be noise
